# galaxy_data_domain (Resource)

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Data Domain name

### Optional

- `contact_user_id` (String) Data Domain contact
- `description` (String) Long form description of the Data Domain
- `role_id` (String) Owning role ID

### Read-Only

- `assigned_data_products` (Attributes List) Data products assigned to this domain (read only) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--assigned_data_products))
- `contact` (Attributes) Created by user. If empty then the user is inactive/deleted. (read only) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--contact))
- `created_by` (Attributes) Created by user. If empty then the user is inactive/deleted. (read only) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--created_by))
- `created_on` (String) Creation date (read only)
- `data_domain_id` (String) Data Domain ID (read only)
- `id` (String) Terraform import identifier.
- `is_default` (Boolean) True if this is the account's default domain (read only)
- `modified_by` (Attributes) Created by user. If empty then the user is inactive/deleted. (read only) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--modified_by))
- `modified_on` (String) Modified date (read only)
- `owning_role` (Attributes) Roles assigned to this group (read only) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--owning_role))
